science_vegetable: Magnetohydrodynamic Kelvin-Helmholtz shear across the ferrofluid sea
summary: Kaio attempts to chart the fluctuating magnetic corridors above the churning ferrofluid sea to guide Ryn's logistical reinforcements through the chaos.

horizon_goals.immediate_session_goal: Avert the devastating feedback loop of the magnetohydrodynamic Kelvin-Helmholtz shear.
horizon_goals.mid_term_milestone: Reinforce the foundational support structures of The Stormbreaker.
horizon_goals.campaign_arc_climax: Adapt the colony to the exoplanet's unpredictable magnetosphere.

active_location.macro_silhouette: The Stormbreaker Spire thrusts violently into the ozone-choked sky, its copper grounding masts vibrating under the chaotic strain of the local magnetosphere. Blinding white arcs of geode static leap between the induction vanes, illuminating the churning, spiky obsidian waves of the ferrofluid sea below in rhythmic strobe flashes. The gale-force winds howl through the lattice, threatening to tear any loose rigging right off the superstructure. Below the observation gantry, a swirling vortex of magnetic turbulence bends the very air into shimmering mirages.

sensory_palette.sight_and_color: Blinding white corona flashes, oxidized green copper, shimmering mirages, and the deep, shifting obsidian of the ferrofluid sea below.
sensory_palette.sound: The deafening howl of ozone-gales, the frantic sparking of live voltage, and the heavy sloshing impact of ferrofluid.
sensory_palette.smell: Sharp, acrid ozone, hot melted brass, and the earthy fungal scent of the spore fog whipping by.
sensory_palette.tactile_temperature: A freezing gale laced with sudden, blistering waves of dry heat radiating from the arcing busbars.
sensory_palette.taste_optional: A sharp, metallic tang of static electricity.

interactive_features.affordance_description: Can be stabilized to accurately map the shear wave vectors.
Can be exposed to draw errant arcs away from the catwalk.
Can be navigated by tossing magnetized flares to reveal hidden pathways.

reactive_toys.motivation_goal: Destabilize the spire's magnetic containment field.
reactive_toys.consistent_method: Pulsing erratic magnetic spikes that strip the copper grounding.
reactive_toys.immediate_complication: The Kelvin-Helmholtz shear is creating localized gravity wells, threatening to crush the approaching supply crawler.
reactive_toys.uninterrupted_escalation: If ignored, the shear wave will rip the gantry apart and scatter the supplies into the churning sea.

three_levels_of_why.level_1_immediate: The magnetohydrodynamic shear is masking the safe approach vectors for the supply crawler.
three_levels_of_why.level_2_local: The storm's intensity has scrambled the standard navigational beacons.
three_levels_of_why.level_3_campaign_arc: The exoplanet's shifting magnetosphere is rejecting the Enclave's attempts to establish permanent footholds.

judge_tactician.failure_stakes_declared: Kaio misreads the magnetic corridors, sending Ryn's crawler into a gravity well and losing critical structural supports.

graduated_outcomes.nat_1_false_intuition: Kaio's compass shatters under the strain, blinding them entirely to the shear waves and plunging the gantry into darkness.
graduated_outcomes.below_dc_complicated_fail_forward: Kaio charts a path, but it forces Ryn to ditch half the cargo to escape a sudden ferrofluid surge.
graduated_outcomes.meets_dc_clean_success: Kaio perfectly predicts the Kelvin-Helmholtz shear, guiding Ryn's crawler safely through the turbulent magnetic sea.
graduated_outcomes.dc_plus_5_or_20_extended_lore: Kaio not only guides the crawler but uncovers a stable subterranean magnetic artery that could bypass the storms entirely.

master_narrator.agency_handoff_prompt: Kaio grins through the ozone-choked gale, his brass sextant spinning wildly as he maps the impossible magnetohydrodynamic shear. He tosses a glowing, magnetized flare down toward the churning ferrofluid, illuminating a narrow, stable corridor. 'Ryn! I found the eddy! Gun the crawler through the trough before the wave crashes!'
